title: Coalesce unread span prefix so options can apply
description:
# Coalesce unread span prefix so options can apply

## Intent

As a copy-editing agent, I want rewrite options that start later in a flagged excerpt to keep the unread prefix, so wiki-janitor-style spans can still produce two valid options instead of fail-closing after retry.

## Done when

- `_coalesce_span_prefix` prepends unread excerpt bytes when a replacement aligns with a later substring.
- Options normalization coalesces before the prefix-skip drop, so suffix-start LLM patches become full-span replacements.
- Apply coalesces the selected replacement the same way, then still rejects if the result would skip the prefix.
- Tests: suffix-start options succeed without requiring a retry; apply of a coalesced suffix replacement preserves the prefix on the working copy; original unchanged.
- Existing retry remains for cases that still cannot meet two options after coalesce.

## Out of scope

Silently applying to `--original`. Changing published files.

```gherkin
Feature: Prefix-coalesced rewrite options
  Scenario: Suffix-start replacements become full-span options
    Given a finding excerpt that starts with unread prefix text
    And a resolver returns replacements that start at a later sentence
    When I generate rewrite options
    Then at least two options remain
    And each replacement begins with the unread prefix

  Scenario: Apply keeps the unread prefix
    Given a working copy and a coalesced option
    When I apply that option
    Then the working copy still contains the unread prefix
    And the original file is unchanged
```
